notes.title: Patch Notes 002
notes.content:
Changes 

Added Health Bar & Oxygen text next to the bars 

Added new Health Bar & Oxygen assets 

Added outline for interaction text 

Added credit names 

Added an intro screen for the end game goal 

Added intro end game text 

Added door and station signs 

Added sound effects for low health and oxygen 

Added new charging station model 

Added new UI changes to inventory, & hotbar

Adjusted elevator level panel 

Adjusted intro goal screen time 

Adjusted the starting crate inventories again because they reset to default testing 

Adjusted the oxygen and health bar placements

Made minor changes to the space station

Fixed getting stuck in the rocket hole 

Fixed the hallway sparks volume settings 

Fixed tooltip going off screen when hovering over an item in he inventory 

Fixed known bug: issue where the Space Station gate is open when the player closes the elevator door from the crater bed 

Known Bugs 

Flashing tooltip when hovering over an item in the inventory with the mouse (Not on controller) 

Frame loss when looking around the lights 

Elevator speed going down into the crater sometimes causes the player to pop out of the roof when moving or looking around.
